summary: Reset + preflight protect every case ticket (cases/*.toml ticket.key), not only RTEMS-1..6
description:
[claude] The second bug-replay case (ANVIL-42) filed its ticket as **RTEMS-7**. The demo tooling assumes RTEMS-1..6 is the whole baseline:

* `backend/scripts/reset_demo.py` deletes RTEMS-7+ that carry an agent label (`anvil*`, tc3, tc4...). RTEMS-7 survives today only because it has no `anvil` label yet. The first time someone labels it to run the case, the next reset deletes it.
* `scripts/preflight.ps1` check 6 expects "RTEMS-7+ purged" and probably fails now.

## Change (generic, no hard-coded keys)

* Protected tickets = RTEMS-1..6 baseline ∪ `{case.ticket_key for case in anvil.cases.load_cases()}`.
* Reset: for case tickets, reset status to To Do and labels to the case file's labels minus `anvil`. Never delete them.
* Preflight check 6: the same set.
* Unit test: a case ticket above 6 is reset, not deleted.

## Acceptance

`reset-demo.ps1 -Jira -DryRun` reports RTEMS-7 as "reset", not "delete". Preflight check 6 passes with RTEMS-7 present.

Owner: antigravity (author of reset/preflight). Not urgent before the rehearsals, unless preflight check 6 blocks them.
